scope: Vercel build-internal exact-source staging provenance before EntityOS Sandbox execution
hypothesis: A canonical committed-tree source TAR derived with git archive can differ from the raw Git tree because committed export attributes can transform or omit tracked blobs, weakening exact source-tree provenance even when the Git tree SHA is recorded separately.
strongest_counterhypothesis: git archive is sufficiently exact for source staging because it is derived from the immutable commit object and therefore cannot materially diverge from committed source bytes.

unusual_experiment.name: GIT_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_ATTRIBUTE_PROVENANCE_DRIFT
unusual_experiment.intervention: Synthetic Git repository committed payload.txt with export-subst and secret.txt with export-ignore, then archived exact HEAD with git archive and compared extracted bytes/presence against raw HEAD blobs.

repair.mechanism: Replace git archive source materialization with git ls-tree -r -z plus git cat-file raw blobs, preserving tracked regular/executable/symlink modes and failing closed on unsupported tree entries or non-UTF8 paths; retain separate SHA-bound credential-free Git bundle for exact commit provenance.
repair.local_deterministic_regression: PASS for export-subst, export-ignore, executable mode and symlink preservation

entityos_impact: Strengthens exact-source identity of the build-internal path that must eventually produce and validate the one-file EntityOS artifact. Does not establish current EntityOS build/runtime PASS.

If the branch advances, bind and test the new exact head instead.
